text.Recycling Station:
How to Play ==
When you play Recycling Station you get the choice between 1 trade or discard up to two cards and then draw that many cards. The station is Outpost with a defense of 4.
 Strategy ==
As a early pick the Recycling Station is gold. And during the game it stays useful. And that for only 4 trade. The powerful ability to draw up 2 new cards cannot be underestimated. Only downside is the 4 defense making it a flymsy outpost which most of the time is targeted first.
